invariants.rationale: partitionPath must not be null to identify the partition being updated.
fileId must not be null to identify the file being merged.
A non-null Iterator of HoodieRecord is required in order to provide records for merging.
partitionPath is very likely a non-empty path string to denote a non-root partition.
fileId should be non-empty in order to perform an update associated with a particular file.
